source.title: Neurons in the orbitofrontal cortex encode economic value.

confidence_rationale: Landmark, heavily-replicated primate single-unit study (source_quality 0.95) establishing that OFC encodes the value of OFFERED goods independently of visuospatial position and motor response -- the option-specific (per-good) value coding MECH-359's 'affect must be candidate-differentiated' currently lacks a neuroscience anchor for. Mapping is solid for the per-OPTION differentiation (0.78) but partial: OFC offer-value is a scalar good-value, whereas MECH-359 posits a MULTI-CHANNEL affect vector per candidate (curiosity/safety/harm-sensory/harm-affective/effort/relief/blocked-agency). It grounds the per-candidate axis, not the multi-channel axis. exp_conf unchanged 0 -- PROMOTES NOTHING (claim is implementation_phase v4 / substrate_conditional).
failure_signatures: OFC offer-value is a single economic value per good, not a multi-channel affect vector; this paper evidences the per-option differentiation MECH-359 needs but says nothing about the curiosity/safety/harm-affective channel decomposition.

Choice-between-goods framing ('value independent of action') is the OPPOSITE emphasis to MECH-360's expression-as-action-geometry; the per-candidate value here is action-abstracted, whereas REE attaches the affect vector to E3 candidate TRAJECTORIES.

mapping.source_claim_statement: During economic choice, OFC neurons encode the value of offered and chosen goods independently of visuospatial factors and motor responses; if a monkey chooses between A and B, OFC encodes the value of the two goods regardless of side or response -- choice is essentially between goods, not between actions.
mapping.ree_translation: OFC offer-value neurons are the biological existence proof that the brain represents value PER OPTION before a motor commitment -- exactly the substrate MECH-359 generalises when it asserts each E3 candidate trajectory must carry its own (cross-candidate-differentiated) affect contribution rather than a scalar added equally to all K candidates. A scalar cannot move an argmax; an option-keyed value can.
mapping.mapping_caveat: OFC offer-value is a single economic-value scalar per good; MECH-359 is a multi-CHANNEL per-candidate affect vector. This paper grounds the per-candidate (option-specific) requirement, NOT the multi-channel decomposition, and not the affect (vs reward-value) content. It is also action-abstracted (value before action), whereas REE binds the affect vector to candidate action-trajectories.
mapping.source_context: Single-unit recordings, macaque OFC, juice/food economic-choice task; primate electrophysiology.

confidence_components.notes: Weighted toward mapping_fidelity for this architectural claim. High source quality is discounted by the scalar-value vs multi-channel-affect gap and the monkey-economic-choice -> REE-proto-affect transfer.
